evals.name: smart-energy-monitor
evals.prompt: We shipped a smart home energy monitor that tracks household electricity room by room, shows cost projections, and sends push alerts when usage spikes. Fill out a Bad Design Canvas — stress-test whether we've built something that increases anxiety, creates surveillance dynamics between housemates, or punishes people who can't afford to reduce usage.
evals.expected_output: Completed Bad Design Canvas identifying root cause vs. band-aid issues, unintended negative consequences across anxiety, surveillance, and economic dimensions, with redesign recommendations.

evals.name: habit-tracker-app
evals.prompt: Our habit tracker app lets users set daily goals, tracks streaks, sends shame-free reminders, and shares progress with an accountability partner. Run the Bad Design Canvas — I suspect the streak mechanic and social accountability might be doing more harm than good for users with anxiety or perfectionism.
evals.expected_output: Canvas identifying how streak mechanics and social accountability can create compulsive behavior and shame cycles, distinguishing root problems from surface symptoms.

evals.name: ai-content-moderation
evals.prompt: We built an AI content moderation system for a community forum. It auto-removes posts flagged as 'toxic' and gives users a 'community health score.' Apply the Bad Design Canvas — what unintended consequences might arise from automated judgment of human expression?
evals.expected_output: Canvas surfacing issues around false positives silencing marginalized voices, chilling effects on free expression, and the power dynamics of algorithmic moderation.
